Q6113.reason: Common-law arson requires malice, and inadvertently leaving the stove on is only negligence, which does not supply malice.

Q5966.reason: The cardiac cycle is the two phases systole and diastole; any resting interval is part of diastole, not a third phase.

Q8294.reason: Ice’s open hydrogen-bonded lattice makes it less dense than liquid water, so higher pressure favors the liquid and the solid–liquid line slopes negatively.
